name: a-fold-matching-two-files-repairs-neither
breaks: the near-miss repair snaps a marker to an ARBITRARY one of two files that fold alike, so the wrong photograph is put under prose written about a different one, silently and with nothing reported. A fold matching two sent files names a family, not a member (L521). blog_quality.py is the only thing in this repo that rewrites a blog body and it shipped as tier 1 with zero guard entries, so this refusal had never been seen to fail on broken code (#1130, L1)
